chapter: Divorce, Gail Fisher and the move to Los Angeles
title: Moving to Los Angeles in 1967 for Gail's acting career
summary: He kept the New York office and opened a California one when Gail moved to Hollywood and got Mannix.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: How did you bring the business to Los Angeles? You moved to Los Angeles in ’67, so I’m assuming that the business came with you?

No, it didn’t. I still maintain an office in New York. The office stayed in New York. I just opened an office in California. I moved out here because of Gail coming to get into the movie things or whatever – get into what her career was headed for. She’d been an actress. She’d worked at Lincoln Center and did some things before we left New York, some local things as an actress. Then we’re coming to California. Once we got out here and got an agent and all that, then along – Mannix happened. We made a complete move through our move, physically everything but my office – I mean my personal life. We moved the apartment – from where we were staying, we moved everything to California.
Your business during that period, while you were in L.A., were you traveling back and forth?
Yes, traveling a lot. A lot of traveling, back and forth to the office in New York, back and forth with the artists on different things, different projects, yes.
Who do you – do you recall who you represented during that period?
It was pretty much the solid stable of the main people who I was still managing at that time, which is the list we were talking about. That pretty much was it.
